d.ko: URBO: Dream One is a meditative puzzle game where you build houses around the mysterious Tower. Let your mind wander through visions of an enchanted city on an island in the middle of the crystal clear waters of a vibrant lake.
d.en: URBO: Dream One is a meditative puzzle game where you build houses around the mysterious Tower. Let your mind wander through visions of an enchanted city on an island in the middle of the crystal clear waters of a vibrant lake.
d.zh: URBO: Dream One是一款禅意放松解谜游戏。在游戏中，你需要围绕一座神秘之塔建造房屋。在这里，你可以放空心境，让思绪徜徉于岛屿上的梦幻之城，感受清澈湖水带来的梦幻景象。

rv.t: 2048류 건물 합병 게임 무료고 업적 있고 가볍게 즐기기에 좋아서 추천함.
